answer: Payout slots are drawn by sortition weighted by the square of an identity's bond times its age in days: one 1000 POA bond held 30 days weighs 30,000,000, while 100 fakes splitting the same capital at 10 POA each weigh only 300,000 combined. Splitting shrinks total weight a hundredfold, so an attacker chasing many slots must post far more capital than honest users, like terraces rising steeply with each step rather than a flat zephyr of free entries. Bonds, ages and draws sit on-chain, so any verifier replays the sortition and confirms no identity was minted like jade without its weight.
